description.value: Piping Hot is a Taiwanese-style pay-by-weight hot pot restaurant in Richmond where diners select from multiple soup bases and pile their bowls with fresh ingredients weighed at checkout. The restaurant also serves bubble tea, taiyaki ice cream with soft serve, and runs an active loyalty rewards program with rotating promotions. Its strip-mall unit location in central Richmond makes it a substantial refuelling option for cyclists exploring the city.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 26m; rack at 57m; rack at 86m; rack at 89m; rack at 95m; rack at 98m.
